brand.name: Axflow Industries
brand.tagline: Precision flow control solutions for critical industrial applications.

meta.description: Industrial flow control equipment and services for oil & gas, power and chemical processing.

hero.headline: Engineering Reliability Into Every System
hero.subheadline: We design, manufacture and service precision flow control equipment for the world's most demanding industrial environments.

services.headline: Our Product Portfolio
services.subheadline: Engineered solutions across pumps, valves, seals and control systems.

items.title: Industrial Pumps
items.body: Centrifugal, axial and positive displacement pumps engineered for continuous duty in corrosive and high-temperature environments.

items.title: Control Valves
items.body: Globe, butterfly and ball valves with digital positioners for precise process control across all pressure classes.

items.title: Mechanical Seals
items.body: Single, double and tandem seal arrangements engineered to eliminate fugitive emissions.

items.title: Actuators & Controls
items.body: Pneumatic, hydraulic and electric actuators with integrated diagnostic capabilities.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: We evaluate your process conditions and operational requirements before recommending any solution.

steps.title: Engineering
steps.body: Our applications engineers size, select and configure equipment to your exact specifications.

steps.title: Manufacture
steps.body: All equipment is manufactured to order and tested against acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Lifecycle
steps.body: Commissioning support, preventive maintenance and emergency repair — full lifecycle support.

about.headline: Built on Engineering Integrity
about.page_subheadline: Four decades of precision manufacturing and field-proven reliability.
about.body: Axflow was founded in 1978 by process engineers who believed that better equipment engineering meant safer, more efficient plant operations.
about.mission_body_1: We exist to eliminate unplanned downtime in critical processes. Every product we engineer is aimed at keeping your plant running safely and efficiently.
about.mission_body_2: With manufacturing in four countries and service centres in over sixty, we combine global capability with local accountability.
about.team_subheadline: Experienced operators and engineers who have worked in the industries we serve.

values.title: Engineering First
values.body: Every decision starts with the engineering. We don't recommend products that aren't right for the application.

values.title: Standards Compliance
values.body: All products are designed and tested to applicable API, ISO and ASME standards.

values.title: Long-Term Partnership
values.body: Our relationships with customers average over 12 years.

testimonials.text: Axflow specified and delivered a complete pump train for our offshore platform in 14 weeks. The equipment has operated without incident for three years.
testimonials.author: J. Hargreaves
testimonials.role: Rotating Equipment Manager, North Sea Operations

testimonials.text: Their engineering team identified a seal failure mode our own team had missed. That kind of expertise is why we sole-source with Axflow.
testimonials.author: M. Rodrigues
